Brand: Crayola
Category: Drawing & Painting Supplies > Colored Pencils

## Features
12 coloured pencils, ideal art tools for children and adults; Long-lasting, pre-sharpened; Bright, vibrant and intense colours that draw smoothly on paper and are ideal for mixing and blending; Premium quality art tools made from reforested wood; Ages 6

## Description
Unleash the power of kids' imaginations with vibrant Crayola Coloured Pencils in 12 different colours. Crayola Coloured Pencils are ideal for detailed drawing and come presharpened for all your colouring needs. Each pencils gives a smooth, intense colour and are ideal for colour mixing and blending. Each pencil is made from high quality smooth grained wood for easy sharpening and less breakage. The selection comes with 12 bright colours ideal for all types of arts and crafts at home and school. Non toxic. Great for use at home or school, Crayola Coloured Pencils are an essential creative tool for kids. This pack of 12 pre-sharpened coloured pencils contains a range of vivid colours to inspire children's self-expression and imagination. Made with thick, soft leads that won't break easily, the pencils create brightly coloured lines that are perfect for school projects and creating detailed artwork. Ideal for creating and colouring maps, completing art or science projects, and making signs and labels. Crayola Coloured Pencils have an easy-to-grip design for better control and are made with thick, soft lead, so they won't break easily under pressure. MADE FROM REFORESTED WOOD: Crayola Coloured Pencils are created from reforested wood instead of wood from old-growth forests. For every tree used in the manufacturing of Crayola Coloured Pencils, a new tree is planted.
